label: TP
reason: User input from cookies flows directly into an LDAP filter string without proper escaping or validation. The doSomething method performs Base64 encode/decode which does not sanitize special characters needed for LDAP queries. The resulting 'bar' variable is concatenated directly into the LDAP filter string, allowing injection attacks.

evidence.note: User cookie value decoded and passed through doSomething
Base64 decode/encode transformation does not prevent LDAP injection
Unsanitized concatenation of user input into LDAP filter string
